messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert — SEV-2 — AlderBank (eu-west-3 dedicated pool) latency.p99 exceeded threshold
incident-bot: details: metric=latency.p99 threshold=1.2s current=2.35s routes=alder-transact/v1 started=2465012345
sarah (oncall): acknowledging. kicking off a quick war-room. @tom please notify AlderBank SRE and spin a customer incident. i'll coordinate ops. :rotating_light:
raj (infra): pulling pool telemetry and node metrics now — https://console.internal.redwood/pools/eu-west-3/alderbank-dedicated
marie (eng-runtime): checking runtime traces and kernel queues. any recent model or infra deploys to that pool in the last hour?
tom (support): opening INC-24651 and emailing SRE (jenkins@alderbank). Draft to customer: "We're aware of elevated tail latency on your dedicated pool and investigating; no errors observed." sending now. ETA customer ack: ~2m.
AlderBank-SRE: Ack. We're seeing spikes too. We have a scheduled marketing batch starting ~08:00 UTC that could explain burst. We're limiting some jobs but still seeing high tail.
luis (solutions): likely noisy-tenant behavior from the batch. we should consider tenant isolation or fast-fallback to a quantized variant to relieve KV/cache pressure. Have playbook for tenant isolation.
sarah (oncall): raj/marie — can you confirm if the p99 spike is driven by a single tenant? run top-tailers query and grep for alder-transact. share snippets.
raj (infra): running quick query: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL\" https://observability.internal/metrics/top-tenants?pool=alderbank-dedicated&metric=latency.p99`
raj (infra): results (5m window):
```
tenant_id=alder-marketing-03 p99=4800ms requests=12.9k
tenant_id=alder-api p99=1200ms requests=7.8k
other tenants p99<900ms
```
raj (infra): looks like alder-marketing-03 dominates the tail.
marie (eng-runtime): traces show high KV cache miss rate and many long-attention runs (seq_len ~8k). model in-use redwood/gptx-8b-qat. kernel queue stack on gpu-3.
raj (infra): node gpu-3 host CPU creeping high, GPU util ~86% on the offending pod. matches the timeline.
luis (solutions): mitigations: (A) isolate tenant to own node(s), (B) fallback to compatible quantized variant, (C) rate-limit the batch, (D) burst cross-region to eu-west-1 warm spare. Which is fastest?
sarah (oncall): prefer minimal-customer impact fast fix: (1) route the batch tenant to a fallback model variant programmatically, (2) scale the pool temporarily. marie, can runtime push a routing override? raj, request extra nodes. tom, update customer ETA 15m.
marie (eng-runtime): we have a runtime policy API. Pushing route override now:
```
POST /v1/pools/eu-west-3/alderbank-dedicated/routing
{ "tenant": "alder-marketing-03", "route_to": "redwood/gptx-8b-quant-fast", "ttl": 900 }
```
marie (eng-runtime): response 202 accepted. policy applied.
raj (infra): scaling pool via autoscale override: `PATCH /infra/pools/alderbank-dedicated {\"desired_nodes\": 6}` — provisioning two extra nodes (node-78, node-79). images pulling.
incident-bot: action recorded: routing-override applied by marie; pool-scale requested by raj.
sarah (oncall): good. everyone monitor p99 for pool and top tenants. reconvene in 3m with numbers.
marie (eng-runtime): +2m after override: pool p99 dropped to ~1.15s (from 2.35s). alder-marketing-03 p99 now ~700ms on quant-fast.
raj (infra): new nodes registering; gpu contention easing. host CPU back to ~52%. taking more traffic.
AlderBank-SRE: seeing improved metrics, thanks. we'll keep batch throttled a bit while you stabilize.
tom (support): customer update sent: "We routed heavy batch traffic to a compatible fallback and added capacity to your dedicated pool; tail latency improving. We'll send a post-incident report." customer acknowledged.
marie (eng-runtime): note: small quality differences for some prompts on quant-fast. documenting and enabling policy to avoid quant-fast for interactive routes.
sarah (oncall): acceptable short-term. priority is SLOs. plan for controlled rollback to gptx-8b-qat for interactive endpoints once stable.
raj (infra): observed error rate stable ~0.1% (baseline). p95 back under SLO (~300ms).
luis (solutions): long-term recs: scheduled warm capacity for heavy marketing windows, tenant affinity rules, QOS profile for batch tenants. I'll draft a proposal for AlderBank account team.
marie (eng-runtime): applied traffic rule to prevent quant-fast for interactive routes:
```
POST /v1/pools/eu-west-3/alderbank-dedicated/policies
{ "match": "route!=alder-transact/batch", "allow_variants": ["gptx-8b-qat"] }
```
marie (eng-runtime): policy applied.
sarah (oncall): handoff summary -> raj takes primary for follow-up. summary: p99 spike traced to alder-marketing-03 due to long sequences and KV cache misses; applied fallback variant + scale-up; p99 improved from 2.35s to ~0.98s; customer notified; no data integrity issues.
raj (infra): taking over. will monitor for 30m and ensure nodes stabilize. will file infra action items for affinity + autoscale windows.
incident-bot: incident state: mitigated (severity: Sev-2) open_duration=00:28:35 pager_handoff=true
sarah (oncall): post-incident action items assigned: raj: implement permanent tenant-affinity + autoscale window (ETA 3d); marie: create fallback-variant policy template + quality guard (ETA 2d); luis: reserved warm capacity proposal (ETA 5d); tom: post-incident report & customer summary (ETA 1d).
tom (support): compiling timeline, commands, logs, and links for the PIR and customer deliverable.
AlderBank-SRE: thanks for the rapid response. please include the exact commands and recommended config changes for our infra team in the report.
marie (eng-runtime): adding runbook refs: https://runbooks.redwood/tenant-isolation and adding incident notes. will also add a monitoring eval for quant-fast quality drift.
raj (infra): monitoring update: pool p99 ~980ms, alder-marketing-03 p99 ~620ms. will keep thread open until stable for 30m then update for closure.
sarah (oncall): thanks all. if anything regresses ping me and we'll escalate. :pray:
